review.reason: Reviewed complete freight screening proxy per tonne-kilometre. Preserve the supplied freight mode and vehicle class: light-commercial freight uses the complete CH 3.5t light-duty fleet, heavy unspecified diesel freight uses the complete RER heavy-lorry diesel fleet across weight classes and delivery cycles, and generic rail and inland-barge freight use the complete RER services. Do not replace all heavy freight by a 3.5t vehicle or a single 18t long-haul vehicle, replace light-commercial freight by the heavy fleet, or replace full rail transport by train operation. The inspected target services include vehicle production, maintenance, disposal and road/track infrastructure through their linked inventories; add no second vehicle, operation or infrastructure. Positive source and target one-tkm references require factor +1: preserve signed quantities, uncertainty, formulas, foreground suppliers and separate emissions without absolute values, payload normalization, passenger-km conversion or kilometre scaling. These are whole-fleet geographic proxies: source country, vehicle, load, fuel, duty, age and emissions mixtures are not reconstructed. The CH light-duty mix includes diesel, hybrid, gas and battery-electric vehicles and replaces a source generic petrol/diesel light-commercial fleet. The RER heavy-diesel class weights use Swiss 2020 shares. Generic global rail supply can include steam; its steam/diesel/electricity shares are approximated by the RER fleet. No individual steam-transport correspondence is created. Vintage, technology, allocation, assets, background and LCIA equivalence remain unestablished. Only enumerated independently inspected cut-off profiles are approved; unknown profiles and consequential routes remain unsupported. Reverse correspondences require independent inspection.
